decisions.basis: Official PDF extraction explicitly identifies Goody’s Bagre variants, opposing mechanical repetition. Italian primary-text reproduction corroborates generative reconstruction. The edge credits Le Goff’s named use rather than asserting the universal truth of Goody’s claims.

Official PDF selected extraction explicitly attributes the Renaissance memory-theatre interpretations to Yates and praises her book in the Bruno discussion. Specific resource use is supported; underlying book reading and universal acceptance remain disclaimed.

Complete conclusion read in the Italian primary-text reproduction, section6. It treats collective memory as historical reservoir and political stake, advocates democratization and distinguishes history from memory. This supports the bounded programmatic contribution.

independent_reading_extent.official_portuguese_pdf: Initial official repository extraction succeeded for catalogue1990 metadata, Goody passages around printed429 and Yates passages around458–459. Later targeted opens and local download timed out; I did not independently retrieve the complete Portuguese conclusion or its end-credit line.
independent_reading_extent.corroborating_primary_reproduction: https://www.mauronovelli.it/LE%20GOFF%20-%20Memoria.htm — selected Bagre paragraphs and complete section6 conclusion read. This is a third-party reproduction of Le Goff’s Italian text, not commentary; visible transcription defects mean it is not treated as a critical edition.
independent_reading_extent.credits_and_dates: The preparer’s Portuguese chapter-specific Bernardo Leitão/Irene Ferreira credit remains explicitly attributed to its checked end-credit. The Italian reproduction separately credits Cesare de Marchi. No conflation of translators,1990 translation with original essay date, or whole-book reading.
independent_reading_extent.not_read: Underlying Goody/Yates works, complete Le Goff volume, French manifestation and whole Portuguese chapter.

mechanical_checks: All three actual endpoints exist and none of the three directed endpoint pairs already occurs in canonical1.192. Source/reading qualifications are adequate and claims need no expansion.
review_limit: Substantive approval uses independent selected official-PDF reading plus independent complete-conclusion reading in a corroborating primary reproduction; it is not a claim of independent page-by-page Portuguese edition collation.
